rules.statement: Class A airspace does not accept VFR flights.
VFR flights shall not operate above FL195 without specific authorization.
Over populated areas: ≥1000 ft above highest obstacle within 600 m; elsewhere ≥500 ft AGL.
Paris Charles de Gaulle (LFPG) does not accept VFR traffic — CTR forbidden to civil VFR.
Paris Orly (LFPO) does not accept VFR traffic outside published VFR routes.
